homeIntent.title: Start from one clear goal, not from too many menus.
homeIntent.description: Lajukan now prioritizes three core actions: finding what you need, posting listings, and managing activity.
homeIntent.intent1Desc: Search jobs, freelancers, suppliers, property, and business needs from one place.
homeIntent.intent2Desc: Publish the core listing first. Advanced details can follow later.
homeIntent.intent3Desc: Track chats, transactions, listings, and next steps without a heavy dashboard.
homeIntent.howStep1Desc: Enter through search, create, or the activity hub.
homeIntent.howStep2Desc: Search is faster, create has a quick mode, and login is lighter.
homeIntent.howStep3Desc: Chat, transactions, wallet, and support stay connected.
homeIntent.focusTitle: Not every feature upfront. Start with what users actually use most.
homeIntent.focus1: Jobs, freelancers, property, and marketplace still live inside one search.
homeIntent.focus2: Listings can be published quickly and completed later.
homeIntent.focus3: Follow-up work is pulled into one lightweight activity hub.

activityHub.title: Your important next steps live here.
activityHub.description: Not a heavy dashboard. This is a fast summary to search, publish, chat, and move transactions forward.
activityHub.loginPrompt: Please log in to open the activity hub.
activityHub.nextSearchDesc: Start with simple search, then open advanced filters only when needed.
activityHub.nextCreateDesc: Fill the essentials first. Images, files, and promotion can be completed later.
activityHub.nextChatDesc: Open the inbox and reply to the latest chat.
activityHub.draftDesc: {count} draft listings can still be completed anytime.
activityHub.txnDesc: {count} transactions remain open. Check status, payments, or proof of delivery.
activityHub.helpDesc: Support, forum, and transaction status should now be easier to reach from each main flow.

support.nextTitle: If this is not a ticket case, continue from the right flow
support.nextDesc: Support is now positioned as an assist path, not the main path for every issue. Choose the flow closest to your problem.
support.card1Desc: If the issue is about order status, payments, or escrow, start from the transactions page.
support.card2Title: Search again with a clearer intent
support.card2Desc: If you are unsure where to start, go back to search and focus the intent first.
support.card3Desc: If the issue is account access, reset the password and check the security guidance.

chat.afterTitle: After a conversation, users usually continue here
chat.afterDesc: Chat is not the end point. Continue to transactions, publish a listing, or return to search for something else.
chat.after1Desc: If you already have a deal, move to transactions to track progress and payment.
chat.after2Desc: If this chat creates a new need, create the core listing without a heavy form.
chat.after3Desc: See active chats, listing drafts, and other next steps from one place.
chat.emptyDesc: Start from the flows that trigger chat: search, create, or support.
chat.empty1Desc: Start from search to find people, jobs, vendors, or property.
chat.empty2Desc: Post a core need or offer to trigger a new conversation.
chat.empty3Desc: If you are unsure where to start, go to the support hub.

onboarding.nextTitle: After onboarding, your main flow will rotate here
onboarding.nextDesc: Onboarding is narrowed down to direct users into the three core flows: search, create, and manage activity.
onboarding.card1Desc: Search is used to find opportunities, vendors, talent, property, or supply.
onboarding.card2Desc: Quick create is used to publish fast and complete the details later.
onboarding.card3Desc: The dashboard is now a lightweight activity hub for chats, listings, and transactions.

transactions.nextTitle: Transactions are not the final page
transactions.nextDesc: From here, users usually need to continue to payments, chat, or search for another listing. The path is now more explicit.
transactions.card1Desc: If the transaction is not funded yet, go to payments to add balance or check payment instructions.
transactions.card2Desc: If the deal needs clarification, continue the conversation without leaving the transaction flow.
transactions.card3Desc: If this deal is done or cancelled, go back to search for the next step.

payments.nextTitle: After adding balance, users should know where to go next
payments.nextDesc: The wallet is now positioned as a transaction connector, not as a standalone page.
payments.card1Desc: After topping up or checking payment instructions, continue the order status from the transactions page.
payments.card2Desc: See chats, listings, and active transactions from one lightweight page.
payments.card3Desc: If instructions, sync, or top-up status are problematic, continue to the support hub.

profile.nextTitle: The profile now connects users to the next action
profile.nextDesc: The profile is not just a biodata page. From here, users should be able to continue to discovery, publishing, or transaction management without confusion.
profile.card1Desc: Use search to find jobs, vendors, talent, or property that match this profile.
profile.card2Desc: Once the profile is ready, continue with quick create to post a need or an offer.
profile.card3Desc: If this profile is already being used for deals, continue to the transactions page for follow-up.

LoginFlow.title: Sign in without the heavy friction.
LoginFlow.emailStepHint: Sign in quickly with email and password. OTP is only used when the security flow is enabled.
LoginFlow.helperTitle: The login flow is lighter now
LoginFlow.helperPoint1: Start with email and password first.
LoginFlow.helperPoint2: Additional OTP only appears when security configuration enables it.
LoginFlow.helperPoint3: After sign-in, users are routed to the most relevant next flow.
LoginFlow.errorWaitResend: Wait {seconds} seconds before sending OTP again.
LoginFlow.errorOtpRequired: Verify the OTP first before signing in.
LoginFlow.errorSendOtpFailed: Failed to send the login OTP. Please try again.
LoginFlow.errorVerifyOtpFailed: Failed to verify the login OTP. Please try again.
LoginFlow.otpActive: Additional OTP verification is active for this login.
LoginFlow.otpOptional: Login is lighter now. Additional OTP only appears when required by security configuration.

RegisterFlow.emailDesc: We send a verification code to this email before opening the next step.
RegisterFlow.profileDesc: Fill the basics first. The rest can be completed after the account is created.
RegisterFlow.securityPoint1: The email is verified before the account is created.
RegisterFlow.securityPoint2: The password must be strong so the account is safe from the start.
RegisterFlow.securityPoint3: The phone number can be added now or later from the profile.
RegisterFlow.errorSendOtpFailed: Failed to send the OTP. Check the connection and try again.
RegisterFlow.errorOtpTokenMissing: The OTP verification token was not found. Restart the OTP flow.
RegisterFlow.errorVerifyOtpFailed: Failed to verify the OTP. Please try again.
RegisterFlow.errorVerifyFirst: Verify the email OTP first before continuing.
RegisterFlow.errorPasswordLength: Password must be at least 10 characters.
RegisterFlow.errorPasswordUpper: Password must include an uppercase letter.
RegisterFlow.errorPasswordLower: Password must include a lowercase letter.
RegisterFlow.errorCaptchaRequired: Complete the captcha before creating the account.

SupportHub.title: Fast help without dead ends
SupportHub.description: Access the support path that matches your need, from self-service to direct communication with the team.
SupportHub.route1Desc: Answers to the most common questions before creating a ticket.
SupportHub.route2Desc: Discuss with other users and moderators.
SupportHub.route3Desc: Guidance for account recovery, device safety, and transaction protection.

UmkmStorefrontPayment.methodQrisHint: Scan with any banking app or e-wallet, closest to the universal wallet top-up flow.
UmkmStorefrontPayment.methodBcaVaHint: Pay from BCA mobile, myBCA, or ATM using the virtual account number.
UmkmStorefrontPayment.methodMandiriVaHint: Pay from Livin', Mandiri ATM, or other Mandiri channels.
UmkmStorefrontPayment.methodGopayHint: Checkout opens the GoPay channel when supported by the gateway.
UmkmStorefrontPayment.methodShopeePayHint: Continue with ShopeePay when the gateway supports it.
UmkmStorefrontPayment.methodBankTransferHint: Use the gateway's generic virtual account transfer flow.
UmkmStorefrontPayment.loginRequiredHint: Login is required to create the online payment session and sync the order status.
UmkmStorefrontPayment.paymentGatewayHint: Online payment now uses the same checkout session pattern as wallet top-ups. Pick a payment channel, the checkout opens automatically, then the order status can be synced from this page.
UmkmStorefrontPayment.loginToContinuePayment: Log in first to continue the online payment. Your order draft has been saved.
UmkmStorefrontPayment.paymentCreateFailed: Failed to create the order payment session.
UmkmStorefrontPayment.paymentSyncFailed: Failed to sync the order payment status.
UmkmStorefrontPayment.paymentConfirmed: Payment confirmed. The order is now in queue and its status has been updated.
UmkmStorefrontPayment.paymentSessionReady: Payment session created. Open the checkout in a new tab, then return here to monitor the status.
UmkmStorefrontPayment.checkoutAutoOpened: Payment session created and the checkout was opened in a new tab. After paying, come back here to monitor the order status.
UmkmStorefrontPayment.checkoutAutoOpenBlocked: Payment session created, but the browser blocked the automatic tab. Use the checkout button below to continue paying.
UmkmStorefrontPayment.paymentPendingInstruction: The payment session is ready. Use the checkout button or sync the status after payment is completed.
UmkmStorefrontPayment.reusedPendingPayment: An existing pending payment session is being reused so you do not generate a duplicate charge.
UmkmStorefrontPayment.paymentStillPending: Payment is still pending. After you pay, click sync or wait for the automatic status refresh.
UmkmStorefrontPayment.paymentNeedsRetry: The previous payment session is no longer active. Create a new payment session to continue.
UmkmStorefrontPayment.restoredPendingPayment: A previous pending payment session has been restored. You can continue from checkout or sync it from this page.
UmkmStorefrontPayment.preparingCheckoutBody: This tab will automatically redirect to the checkout page as soon as the order payment session is created.
UmkmStorefrontPayment.keepTabOpen: Keep this page open. After payment is completed in another tab or payment app, the order status will update here as well.
UmkmStorefrontPayment.paymentPaidNote: Payment has been received. The order is ready for the store to process.
